o1.why: F2c native column shows separate smooth fibres and the 2 h column shows a smooth continuous sheet region and fibres fused by filling film; the reader called it curling.

o1c.why: The 30 s column shows fibres sunk in a hazy matted film, similar to 2 h as the text says; image_support is already partial for the less complete fusion.

a1.why: Asterisked sharp spikes at ~180, ~52 and ~22 ppm appear only in the native trace and the caption attributes them to crystalline Ala; the reader guessed spinning sidebands.

n12.why: F6b is the authors' model of fused fibres with coiled-coils linked by new beta-sheet arrows; the legend sits outside the crop, so the reader misread it as a weave schematic.
